note: All types are exported from the package root. Static classes have no constructor.

Actor.description: Base class for all actors in the Actor Model. Subclass and implement receive().

NetworkActor.description: Actor extended with a pluggable Transport for multiplayer. Remote messages route into receive() identically to local messages.

ActorSystem.description: Registry and per-frame scheduler for actors. Create one per scene; destroy in onDestroy.

methods.register: (actor: Actor) => void  // throws on duplicate id
methods.update: (dt: number) => void  // flush all inboxes then call update() on running actors

Transport.description: Interface for pluggable network transports. Implement in game code; never import a concrete transport into the engine.

PluginSystem.description: Process-global service registry. Import the singleton directly — do not construct.

methods.register: (plugin: Plugin) => Promise<void>  // throws on duplicate name

NavMeshSystem.description: Polygon-based 2D pathfinding. Load pre-built polygon data; do not generate at runtime.

methods.findPath: (from: Vec2, to: Vec2) => Vec2[]  // returns centroid waypoints, empty if no path
methods.update: (dt: number) => void  // reserved for dynamic obstacles

PhysicsSystem3D.description: Full Rapier3D integration. Must await init() before adding bodies. Must call destroy() in onDestroy to free WASM memory.

methods.destroy: () => void  // required — frees WASM heap allocation

Physics3DHandle.description: Handle returned by PhysicsSystem3D.addBody(). Read transform, apply forces.

PhysicsBody.description: 2D physics component. Attach to an entity. Synchronous — no init required.

CharacterController.description: 2D character movement component. Handles slope, step-up, one-way platforms. Requires a PhysicsBody on the same entity.

options.slopeAngle: number  // max walkable slope in degrees
options.stepHeight: number  // max step-up height in px

Animator.description: Spritesheet animation component. Drives a Sprite component on the same entity.

methods.play: (clipName: string, options?: { loop?: boolean; speed?: number }) => void
methods.onComplete: (cb: () => void) => void  // fires when a non-looping clip ends

InputSystem.description: Low-level keyboard, mouse, and touch input with frame-accurate events. attach() and flush() must be called manually when using this class directly. The high-level Input static class wraps this automatically.

methods.flush: () => void  // call once per frame before reading state

Audio.description: Static audio playback class. Manages sfx, music, and spatial audio.

methods.play: (key: string, options?: { volume?: number; spatial?: boolean; position?: Vec2 }) => void
methods.music: (key: string, options?: { loop?: boolean; fade?: number }) => void
methods.setGroupVolume: (group: string, volume: number) => void  // groups: master, music, sfx, voice, ambient

Camera.description: Static camera controller. Follows entities, shakes, zooms, fades.

methods.follow: (entity: Entity, options?: { lerp?: number; deadzone?: { x: number; y: number } }) => void
methods.zoom: (factor: number, options?: { duration?: number; ease?: string }) => void
methods.fade: (options: { to?: number; from?: number; duration: number }) => void

SaveSystem.description: Async save/load. Uses native filesystem in Tauri, localStorage in browser. Always validate loaded data with a schema.

methods.load: (slot: string) => Promise<{ data: unknown }>  // throws SlotNotFoundError if missing

i18n.description: Localisation singleton. Load locale bundles in onLoad; call setLocale before t().

methods.load: (locale: string, importer: () => Promise<{ default: Record<string, string> }>) => Promise<void>
methods.t: (key: string, vars?: Record<string, unknown>) => string  // returns key if missing, never throws

TilemapSystem.description: Static tilemap loader. Load .esmap files exported from the TilemapEditor panel.

Tilemap.description: Loaded tilemap instance returned by TilemapSystem.load().

TilemapLayer.description: One layer of a loaded tilemap.

methods.enablePhysics: () => void  // generates static PhysicsBody colliders from solid tiles

properties.name: string
properties.entities: Entity[]  // spawn-point entities placed in this layer

Tween.description: Static tween runner. Interpolates numeric properties on any object over a duration.

methods.to: (target: object, props: Record<string, number>, options: TweenOptions) => TweenHandle
methods.from: (target: object, props: Record<string, number>, options: TweenOptions) => TweenHandle

fields.ease: string  // linear | sineIn/Out/InOut | quadIn/Out/InOut | cubicIn/Out/InOut | bounceOut | elasticOut | backIn/Out

Timer.description: Game-loop-integrated timer. Pauses with the scene. Always cancel handles in onDestroy.

LayerSystem.description: Named rendering layers with z-order and entity membership. Lower index = drawn first. Pre-defines 'default' (index 0) and 'ui' (index 1000). Create one per scene and call destroy() in onDestroy.

methods.getLayerIndex: (name: string) => number  // returns 0 for unknown layers
methods.isVisible: (name: string) => boolean  // unknown layers default to true

types.LayerConfig: { name: string; index: number; visible: boolean }
